WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.sku, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id<>999 AND coalesce(w.status,'x')<>'cancelled'),
r AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(rl.quantity_returned) rq, sum(rl.refund_net) rn
 FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=rl.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=rl.store_key
 WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1),
a AS (SELECT sku, sum(quantity) units, sum(net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) staffnet FROM s GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.sku, (SELECT product_name FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku ORDER BY valid_to DESC LIMIT 1) nm, a.units, a.net, a.staffnet, coalesce(r.rq,0) rq, coalesce(r.rn,0) rn, a.net-coalesce(r.rn,0) net_after_ret,
 rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.net DESC) rk_net, rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.units DESC) rk_units, rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.net-coalesce(r.rn,0) DESC) rk_netret
FROM a LEFT JOIN r USING (sku) QUALIFY rk_net<=14 OR rk_units<=14 OR rk_netret<=14 ORDER BY rk_net

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
    AND st.store_id <> 999
    AND coalesce(w.status, 'x') <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY p.sku),
refunds AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(rl.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line rl
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = rl.product_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = rl.store_key
  WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
    AND st.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY p.sku),
names AS (SELECT DISTINCT sku, product_name FROM dim_product)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net,0) DESC) AS rank,
       s.sku, n.product_name, round(s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net,0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sku) JOIN names n USING (sku)
QUALIFY rank <= 10 ORDER BY rank
